label: Security Admin (Server RBAC role)
type: a Server RBAC role introduced in Couchbase Server 8.0, holding the security-administration privileges that were split off from the pre-8.0 Local User Security Admin and External User Security Admin roles. Can configure auditing and manage encryption-at-rest keys; cannot manage local or external users, which moved to role:user-admin-local and role:user-admin-external.
evidence: This role replaced the Local User Security Admin role available in Couchbase Server prior to version 8.0\. The Local User Security Admin role had additional administration privileges that were split off into the [Security Admin](#security-admin) role.
Users with the Full Admin or Security Admin roles can configure Auditing.
